name: b-returns
description: SIMULATED SETTING, not a measurement: link delays are configured so that A-B and B-C (10 ms one way) are cheaper than A-D and D-C (25 ms one way). B stops at 10 s (route moves to D) and starts again at 20 s. Its links become routable again but are held down for 5 s; only then does the controller choose B again, because the simulated B links are cheaper.
